Shop fronts and walls carry no lettered signs at all: at most a plain glowing panel with one single large simple pictogram (a cup, a leaf, a bowl) and nothing else. Screens show only abstract shapes. No letters, words, digits or numbers anywhere. No text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers. No cartoon murals or cartoon animals, and nothing that resembles a known character.
